title: Seeing a UFO while remote viewing Mount Zeal

tellings.quote: Not in a hangar. will uh in the viewing of uh Mount Hayes uh Mount um Mount Zeal.

plain: An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he saw a UFO, not in a hangar but at Mount Zeal in Australia, while remote viewing, which is the practice of trying to perceive faraway places with the mind alone. He tells Michels this from his own sessions, and if true it would mean the method could pick up such craft out in the open.
